ns2:section.sectionText: Quantum Computing. Prerequisites: Linear algebra is a minimal requirement, and some exposure to quantum mechanics is recommended, for example through classes in physics or IGL. Alternatively, students with a background in quantum computing will satisfy the prerequisites. Introduction to basic quantum mechanics and information theory. This will be combined in discussing mathematical tools relevant for quantum information theory. For further information see Math 595 MJ at https://math.illinois.edu/timetable
